title: QUIZ - 46
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Variables on Both Sides with Distribution
questions.learningObjective: Solve an equation with variables on both sides that also requires distributing
questions.question: Solve for n: \( 2(n - 9) = 6n + -46 \)
questions.explanation: Distribute: 2n - 18 = 6n + -46. Move variable terms together: (2-6)n = -28, so n = -28/-4 = 7.
questions.hint: Distribute first if needed, then gather variable terms on one side and constants on the other.

questions.concept: Variables on Both Sides
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation with variable terms on both sides of the equal sign
questions.question: Solve for y: \( 6y - 3 = 7y \)
questions.explanation: Subtract 7y from both sides: (6-7)y + -3 = 0, so (-1)y = 3, giving y = -3.
questions.hint: Move all variable terms to one side and all constants to the other, then solve.

questions.concept: Variables on Both Sides in Word Problems
questions.learningObjective: Set two real-world expressions equal and solve for the variable on both sides
questions.question: Two plans charge based on n: Plan A costs 6n dollars, and Plan B costs 5n plus a $6 fee (in dollars). For what value of n do the two plans cost the same?
questions.explanation: Set the costs equal: \(6n=5n+6\). Subtracting \(5n\) from both sides gives \(n=6\).
questions.hint: Set the two expressions equal to each other and solve for the variable.
